agent.name: Flag
agent.strategy: Bull flag: pole, quiet drift, breakout
agent.description: Well-formed bull flags: forming flags with trigger and stop, and breakouts on volume with a trade.

context.label: Well-formed
context.value: flag vol <= 70% of pole, pullback <= 40%, 5-8 sessions

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 26% pole · 5-session flag · 28% pullback on 44% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows mixed signals. Volume compression is textbook, but the pullback consumed most gains—leaving minimal room to profit if it breaks up. Confirmation requires a clean break above trigger on expanding volume; breakdown below the flag base would suggest the initial move lacked conviction.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 63% pole · 7-session flag · 27% pullback on 46% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows textbook structure but formation-stage flags statistically underperform. Confirmation requires a close above trigger with volume spike; a breakdown below the flag low would likely accelerate losses given the stock hasn't reclaimed its pole high and sits near flag midpoint with no clear directional conviction.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 41% pole · 5-session flag · 20% pullback on 42% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: The flag shows textbook structure but remains unproven. A close above the trigger with volume would suggest conviction, while a breakdown below support would indicate the rally was exhaustion rather than consolidation. Statistically, incomplete flags break down more often than they break out, so skepticism is warranted until price acts.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 51% pole · 5-session flag · 15% pullback on 54% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag lacks conviction: the pullback consumed over half the pole's gains, leaving minimal room for a profitable breakout. A close above trigger with volume exceeding the pole's average would validate it; breaking below the flag low kills it outright. Statistically, forming flags disappoint more often than not.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 60% pole · 5-session flag · 37% pullback on 47% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag lacks conviction—the pullback consumed over a third of the pole's gains while volume dried up, typical of weakening momentum. A close above trigger would need to hold with expanding volume to suggest genuine buyers; a breakdown below the flag low would confirm the uptrend was exhausted.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 44% pole · 6-session flag · 25% pullback on 51% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: Structurally sound—tight consolidation on reduced volume after a sharp run. Confirmation requires a clean break above trigger on volume expansion; breakdown below the flag base would suggest the initial move exhausted, not consolidation. Statistically, this setup has poor odds until proven otherwise.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 15% pole · 5-session flag · 25% pullback on 51% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows textbook structure, but the volume compression during the consolidation is modest—only half the pole's volume, which often precedes breakdowns rather than breakouts. A close above trigger with volume exceeding the pole would confirm strength; a breakdown below $27.52 would likely see it retest the pole base.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 35% pole · 6-session flag · 39% pullback on 49% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag shows mixed signals: the pullback retraced a reasonable portion of the pole, but volume dried up during the consolidation—a warning sign. A break above the flag with volume expansion would confirm the pattern; a close below the flag bottom would invalidate it. The stock needs to prove it still has buyers.

setup.title: Flag
setup.label: 18% pole · 5-session flag · 34% pullback on 48% of pole volume

opportunities.reasoning: This flag has concerning geometry: the pole is weak relative to the flag's size, and volume dried up during consolidation—classic signs of waning conviction. A break above resistance would need to reclaim the pole high on expanding volume to suggest real follow-through; a close below the flag low kills it outright.
